query: SELECT count(*) AS "created!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.sent_at IS NOT NULL) AS "sent!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'completed') AS "completed!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'declined') AS "declined!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'voided') AS "voided!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'expired') AS "expired!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'completing')) AS "in_progress!", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM e.completed_at - e.sent_at)::float8) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'completed' AND e.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND e.completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS median_seconds, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM e.completed_at - e.sent_at)::float8) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'completed' AND e.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND e.completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS p90_seconds FROM envelopes AS e WHERE e.account_id = $1 AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM envelope_states AS s WHERE s.account_id = e.account_id AND s.envelope_id = e.id) AND e.created_at >= $2 AND e.created_at < $3 AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR e.sender_user_id = $4)
